question: What will be the Paraguay River level at Asunción on December 31, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Asunción was 3.07 m on Nov 27, rising 25-27 cm a day; a large flood wave is still building upstream (Concepción 4.79 +41, Vallemí 5.45 +35, Murtinho 4.76 +42), and the Paraná is surging again (Itaipú releases, Puerto Tigre record), so backwater supports Asunción. Expect a peak around 4.0-4.8 m in early-to-mid December. Analog: the October crest of 3.02 m fell about 6 cm/day afterward, which would leave about 3.1-3.4 m by Dec 31 with no new rain. El Niño and the above-normal December rain outlook make more pulses likely, so the upper tail past 4.205 m is real (~22%). No human prediction market found.
calls.reference_class: Asunción Paraguay River level about 3-5 weeks after a rapid tributary-driven rise, using the Oct-Nov 2026 crest-and-recession and El Niño-year December behavior (2015 analog for the high tail)

calls.reasoning: Asuncion was 3.07 m on Nov 27, rising 25 cm/day, with a large flood wave upstream: Concepcion 4.79 m (+41 cm/day, +3.15 m since Nov 15) and Porto Murtinho 5.03 m after 300-370 mm of rain. INA (Nov 27) sees a significant chance of Puerto Pilcomayo passing its alert level (~4.85 m at Asuncion) from Dec 3, with the crest 7-15+ days out, above-normal rain into early December and longer residence times. Projection: crest ~5 m in the first half of December, then about 3 weeks of 4-6 cm/day recession gives ~4 m on Dec 31 (median ~4.1). The Oct 2026 wave fell ~6 cm/day, which bounds the low side; El Nino rain and Parana backwater bound the high side. Percentiles are conditional on landing inside the range. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.

calls.reasoning: Asuncion was 3.07 m on 27 Nov and rising 25 cm/day. Upstream gauges were still rising fast (Murtinho 2.10->4.76, Concepcion 1.64->4.79, Fuerte Olimpo +30 cm/day) after more than 300 mm of rain, and a high Parana (Pilar 5.17) adds backwater. INA expects Puerto Pilcomayo (about 0.4 m above Asuncion) to peak in 7-15+ days, with a significant chance of passing the 5.35 m alert level and possibly nearing 6.0 m, which implies an Asuncion crest of about 5-5.6 m in early to mid December. A recession of 3-7 cm/day over the remaining roughly 20 days gives a median near 4.0 m on 31 Dec, skewed up by El Nino December rain. No market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
